description: This file defines the LDAP Configuration API class for an OrangeHRM plugin, which provides methods to get and update LDAP settings via REST API endpoints, including validation, data mapping, and managing LDAP configuration state.

classes.name: LDAPConfigAPI
classes.description: Defines API endpoints for managing LDAP configuration settings including retrieval and updates, validation, and associated data models.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles updating LDAP configuration settings, validating input, setting data and user lookup settings, and saving the configuration.

methods.name: setConfigAttributes
methods.description: Sets LDAP configuration attributes such as enable status, hostname, port, encryption, and LDAP implementation, as well as bind user details and sync options.

methods.name: setDataMappingAttributes
methods.description: Configures data mapping attributes in LDAP settings using input from the request.

methods.name: setUserLookupSettings
methods.description: Adds user lookup settings to LDAP configuration from provided array input.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating LDAP configuration, excluding system ID parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception; placeholder for LDAP config deletion endpoint.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception; placeholder for delete validation rules.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves the current LDAP configuration, returning default if not set.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for fetching one LDAP configuration, excluding ID parameters.
